scope: Eight encoded-antigen and controlled-response construction/source paths at both pins, plus two complete embedding parents and full original-to-later differences. Not a replacement ordinary-lesson denominator.

units.requirement: Three fictional encoded targets A, B and C do not imply three equally strong measured responses.
Subtracting the same matched background of five from raw spot counts 45, 11 and 5 yields adjusted counts 40, 6 and 0, all per 200,000 plated PBMCs.
The common-baseline bar widths 320, 48 and 0 use eight SVG units per adjusted spot, with C a zero marker rather than a positive bar.
C is undetectable under the fictional protocol and its replicate/positivity rules; zero adjusted spots is not a universal biological absence threshold.
C zero does not prove absent natural tumor display, a universally useless target or a missing tumor antigen.

Matched per-target stimulation, sample/time, denominator and background/positive controls are needed to describe the measured hierarchy; peptide response alone does not establish natural tumor display or killing.
Immunodominance is a setting-dependent response hierarchy, not a universal target ranking or fixed weighting formula.
Encoded sequence count, measured response distribution and useful immune breadth are different quantities; the example supplies no clone-pruning or marker requirement.

The source-check assertion about precursor availability and peptide binding is bounded to its actual viral or human study context; binding prediction alone does not strictly determine measured response strength.
The fictional vaccine keeps the encoded set A and B fixed, while a response to unencoded C becomes newly detectable.
The matched baseline/follow-up matrix keeps A and B positive and changes C from ND to positive; ND means not detected.
Newly detected C is not proof that a C-reactive cell or receptor never existed at baseline or was newly created.
A larger response to the same target A is magnitude/expansion, not an additional recognized epitope.
The one-to-many A icons are qualitative, not empirical assay counts, rates or a measured threefold response.

An additional specificity requires a defined target-specific assay with matched baseline, background and presentation controls; target recognition and a receptor-sequence change answer different questions.
Additional sampled TCR sequences or clonotype diversification alone do not identify additional antigen specificities or prove spreading.
Baseline sampling/detection limits, cross-reactivity and accompanying treatment complicate attribution of new detection to the vaccine.
Additional target recognition is an immune finding and does not by itself establish tumor control, recurrence prevention, safety or clinical benefit.

The schematic does not demonstrate rewriting a mature receptor. Expansion or recruitment of different existing specificities and newly detectable recognition must be kept separate from de novo receptor creation.

Two independent-owner reviews and two authorship/provenance records are supporting evidence with scientific assertions separately assessed, not present scientific, expert, learner, adoption or release approvals.

Historical source/preimage/current-owner, output, prompt, package and review hashes must be checked against their named public pinned bodies; unmatched/private references are retained without guessed substitutions.

Full saved review bodies were read, but their claimed screenshots, source excerpts, browser checks, minimum contrast, keyboard actions and PASS labels are not repeated or adopted as this cohort own review.

Four complete fresh native theme views are local source renders with explicit colors and transparent gutters; no live browser, physical mobile, quantitative contrast, accessibility or hydration acceptance is claimed.
The same geometry/text/data and nominal font arithmetic can be checked computationally, but do not establish native deployment or actual small-screen readability.
Prior reviewer reading was abstract/legend/excerpt depth with access failures; no whole-paper or source-figure reading is inherited or upgraded by source-body retrieval alone.
Private author/reviewer paths, package seals and source-control references are historical attestations; no private review target is followed or published.

Both pinned ordinary inventories, old artwork grades, pending packets and source depth remain preserved; these eight asset paths do not replace the parent-lesson denominator or close broader residuals.
